newsitem.title: USA: Burlington files $300 mln shelf offering.
newsitem.headline: Burlington files $300 mln shelf offering.

text.p: Burlington Resources Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering for up to $300 million in debt securities.
The offering totals $500 million when added with a previous registration, the Houston-based company said.

Proceeds from the sale will be added to the company's working capital for general corporate purposes including the acquisition of oil and gas properties, repayment of outstanding commercial paper, capital expenditures and repurchasing common shares.
No underwriters were named in the SEC filing.
